title: TWICE (Ezetimibe Together With Any Statin Cholesterol Enhancement)(0653-060)

sections.abstract: In patients with primary hypercholesterolemia treated with a statin and with ldl-c above the recommended target goal (esc 2003 recommendations ldl\>=1.15 g/l) to compare the efficacy and the safety of ezetrol added to ongoing statin and non drug therapeutic intervention (patient motivation on diet or physical activities or both).
